title: Surviving As the Butler of the Connett Estate
titleEnglish: Surviving As the Butler of the Connett Estate
synonyms: The Survival Log of a Butler at the Count's Castle
synopsis: After her treacherous cousin steals her title and fortune, then tries to sell her into marriage, Brienne cuts her hair and disguises herself as a boy to escape. She finds refuge at the Connett Estate—located in a domain that acts as a self-governed city immune to imperial law—working as an assistant butler to the formidable Duke Ulrich Connett. Though feared across the empire as a ruthless war monster, Brienne discovers a surprisingly warm heart underneath his cold exterior—while Ulrich finds himself captivated by his brilliant, fiercely capable new aide. (Source: WEBTOON)

synonyms: A Story Of Taking Home A Lonely Gal From My Class And Turning Her Into An Elegant Beauty
Class no botti GAL wo omotikaeri shite seisokei-bijin ni shiteyatta hanashi
synopsis: On a rainy night, Akira Akamori, a high school boy about to transfer to a new school, sees his blonde-haired classmate, Aoi Sotome, standing in the park drenched from the rain. “…I don’t have a home anymore.” Though he doesn't know Aoi well at all, Akira couldn’t leave a girl alone in the rain, so he took her home. “Thanks for the help.” “Y- You're welcome…” When Akira hears about Aoi’s complicated situation, he decides to help her and let her live with him until he transfers to his new school. While their new cohabitation arrangement seems a little confusing at first, the two slowly grow close to each other. It is a love story of two people who repeatedly come together and drift apart, like a spinning record.

While his two sisters, both veterans in this world, criticize his choices of equipment, he continues to delve into the skill sets he has acquired.
